title: cardamine scutata subsp. fallax
intro: Cardamine scutata subsp. fallax, commonly known as fallax bittercress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of fallax bittercress include its potential use as an antimicrobial agent, and its ability to aid in the relief of respiratory issues and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Cardamine scutata subsp. fallax include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to have potential anti-cancer properties and are responsible for its pungent flavor and aroma.
